start: A member on an Android phone, not in a gym, on the Profile tab

user_sees: Page 'Settings' with groups 'You', 'Workouts', 'Your gym', 'Phone and watch', 'Your data', 'Help'; each row with its current value (for example 'Rest 2:00', the units, the profile name)
must_not: A row line that shows the old value after a change; a row that opens nothing

user_sees: The Weekly goal page opens once
must_not: Two pages stacked after a fast double tap

user_sees: Page 'More workout choices' with 'How the app picks your next weight', 'Previous numbers', 'Muscle tips', each with its current value
must_not: A row missing its value line

start: A member in a gym that has a logo and a live leaderboard, on Settings

user_sees: Rows 'Gym logo on my home screen', 'What my gym can see' and 'Leave <gym>' in red as the last row
must_not: 'Join your gym' shown to a member who is in a gym

user_sees: The What my gym can see page
must_not: Leave started by a tap on another row

user_sees: No 'Reminders' row; 'Phone and watch' group shows 'Not on iPhone yet: reminders, rest alerts, your watch, Health apps and widgets. They come in a later update.'
must_not: A Widgets or Health apps row that cannot work on iPhone

start: A member with no gym, no watch, no Health Connect on the phone

user_sees: 'Your gym' shows only 'Join your gym' with 'Type your gym's code or scan its poster'; no 'Your watch' or 'Health apps' row
must_not: An empty group; a row whose page cannot work on this phone

user_sees: The Gym tab's join screen (a tab switch, not a page on top of Settings)
must_not: A Settings page stacked on the Gym tab

start: A member who changes a setting and comes back

steps.action: From Settings open 'Units', pick a new unit, go back
user_sees: The 'Units' row line shows the new unit
must_not: The old line until the app restarts

steps.action: Turn Health Connect on in its page, go to the home screen and back
must_not: The row line not refreshed on return

user_sees: The group changes to 'Join your gym'
must_not: Leave and What my gym can see rows still showing
